answer: Require every identity to escrow a 820-unit bond and serve a thirty-seven epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for seventeen rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 820 units per alias and replays thirty-seven rounds, while a relic of matched traces exposes the ring, summit markers flag copied content, and thread links expose coordinated clusters.
